Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Reference-free Monolithic Preference Optimization with Odds Ratio (arXiv 2403.07691v1) · evaluates on: The paper uses GPT-4 as judge in AlpacaEval1.0 and MT-Bench, and GPT-4-turbo in AlpacaEval2.0, with text-davinci-003 and GPT-4 references respectively for the two AlpacaEval versions.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Reference-free Monolithic Preference Optimization with Odds Ratio (arXiv 2403.07691v1) · paper method: ORPO combines supervised chosen-response NLL loss with a weighted log-sigmoid odds-ratio loss comparing chosen and rejected responses.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Reference-free Monolithic Preference Optimization with Odds Ratio (arXiv 2403.07691v1) · paper method: ORPO updates the model directly without retaining a separate frozen reference model; the paper compares this computation to its stated RLHF/DPO training setup.
